run_compression_tests: run the gRPC client and server side compression unit tests with unittest
test_compression_configuration: test a specific gRPC compression configuration across channel, multicallable, and server settings
create_generic_rpc_handler: create a GenericRpcHandler that routes unary and streaming RPC methods to handlers
set_call_compression: set the compression method on a gRPC servicer context for the current call
measure_compression_ratios: measure byte-level compression ratios between two gRPC client-server configurations
